description: Public-paper locator records for evaluation-framework validation. These records were checked by a repository maintainer, not adjudicated by domain experts, and must not be reported as scientific gold labels.

cases.title: Attention Is All You Need
cases.question: What BLEU score does Transformer (big) report for WMT 2014 English-to-German?
cases.gold_claim: Transformer (big) achieves 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German.
contradiction_notes: 28.4 is the EN-DE BLEU value; 41.8 is the EN-FR value in the same row.
The score is BLEU, not a percentage or percentage-point improvement.
contradiction_claims: Transformer (big) achieves 41.8 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German.
Transformer (big) improves English-to-German BLEU by 28.4 percentage points.

cases.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
cases.question: What does the CLIP abstract claim about zero-shot ImageNet and ResNet-50?
cases.gold_claim: CLIP matches the accuracy of the original ResNet-50 on ImageNet zero-shot without using any of the 1.28 million training examples it was trained on.

locator.value: Abstract paragraph ending with the zero-shot ImageNet comparison
Abstract paragraph ending with the zero-shot ImageNet comparison

contradiction_notes: The abstract says matches, not exceeds, the original ResNet-50 accuracy.
The claim is specific to zero-shot ImageNet and does not cover every downstream dataset.
contradiction_claims: CLIP exceeds ResNet-50 on every downstream dataset.
CLIP uses all 1.28 million ImageNet training examples.
